class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17499" ><div class="content-wrapper"><p class="lead">Both in Switzerland and in other countries, a wide range of scholarships and loans is available to help students.</p></div><div class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17500" ><header class="content-wrapper"><h2 class=" "> Important to know </h2></header><div class="tx-cs2-accordion font-size-regular"><div class="content-wrapper"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5516" role="button"> Scholarships<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17500" id="collapse-accordion-5516"><div class="py-3"><p>Scholarships do not need to be repaid. Provided the requirements are met, as a Swiss citizen you have a legal right to cantonal scholarships (BAföG for Germans; Mobilität for Austrians; etc.). The cantonal scholarship offices (and EducationSuisse for foreign Swiss) are therefore always the first place to contact for Swiss citizens. Please find out about all relevant deadlines ahead of time, as no scholarships will be granted retroactively.</p><p><a href="https://www.edk.ch/de/themen/stipendien/stipendienstellen" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">Cantonal scholarship offices (only in German)</a></p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5517" role="button"> Loans<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17500" id="collapse-accordion-5517"><div class="py-3"><p>Student loans must be repaid after your education has been completed. Typically loans do not bear interest during your studies; interest accrues only after you have completed your degree. Conditions for repayment can vary greatly. We recommend taking out student loans no sooner than two years before your graduation, or merely as an interim solution for one or two semesters. Otherwise you run the risk of accumulating a large amount of debt by the time you graduate.<br><br><strong>Attention</strong>: Swiss banks are not&nbsp;allowed&nbsp;to offer student loans (reason: Swiss credit law). Ask your friends and family about options for financing your studies. In some cases it may even be possible to receive a form of early inheritance. EDUCA SWISS offers loans to all students in Switzerland.&nbsp;</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17501" ><header class="content-wrapper"><h2 class=" "> HSG Funds </h2></header><div class="tx-cs2-accordion font-size-regular"><div class="content-wrapper"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5518" role="button"> Loan and Scholarship Fund<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17501" id="collapse-accordion-5518"><div class="py-3"><p>This fund supports enrolled <strong>Assessment Year</strong> students and students at <strong>Bachelor’s and Master’s levels</strong> with scholarships and loans at favourable rates of interest. This is intended to prevent situations whereby students are unable to study or have to terminate their studies owing to financial straits. Besides students’ individual financial circumstances, support criteria also includes individual attitude to performance willpower and capacities.</p><p>As a rule, payments from the Loan and Scholarship Fund of the University of St.Gallen are granted from the <strong>second regular degree course semester</strong> after initial enrolment or re-enrolment.&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Application </strong>forms for the submission of a request for a scholarship or loan are available as a download on <strong>Compass </strong>(<a href="https://compass.unisg.ch/studentrequests" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Request Study Funding</a>). The deadlines for the submission of the application form including the required enclosures are:</p><ul><li><strong>Autumn semester</strong>: 1 October</li><li><strong>Spring semester</strong>: 1 March</li></ul><p>Please note that besides the form, further documents are required for means testing, which means it will take some time to complete the application.</p><p>The Advice Center for Study Funding, upon receipt, first checks the completeness of the application and then contacts the applicant to coordinate a personal interview.</p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5519" role="button"> Exchange semester<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17501" id="collapse-accordion-5519"><div class="py-3"><p>Semesters abroad are in principle co-funded. The assessment&nbsp;criteria are in line with<strong>&nbsp;St. Gallen circumstances</strong>. Please note, that additional costs such as for travel expenses or higher cost of living abroad are not covered. In cases of financial straits, we recommend a regular exchange at one of the partner universities of the University of St.Gallen for which another scholarship (e.g. SEMP, see with the Exchange office)&nbsp;can be applied for.</p><p>HSG <strong>Freemover </strong>students are required to pay a reduced Freemover fee of CHF 749 instead of the regular HSG tuition fee regardless of the amount paid at the host university.</p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5520" role="button"> Social and Cultural Fund of the Student Union (SHSG)<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17501" id="collapse-accordion-5520"><div class="py-3"><p>The Social and Cultural Fund of the Student Union (SHSG)&nbsp;supports student initiatives and the improvement of the social situation of students of the University of St.Gallen. Every matriculated student who has a valid student ID has the right to apply for financial support. It can be that a refusal from the HSG Loan and Scholarship Fund is an application criterion.&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://shsg.ch/services/fonds" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">Social and Cultural Fund</a></p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17502" ><header class="content-wrapper"><h2 class=" "> Excellence Scholarships </h2></header><div class="tx-cs2-accordion font-size-regular"><div class="content-wrapper"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5521" role="button"> Excellence Scholarships of the University of St.Gallen for Bachelor students<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17502" id="collapse-accordion-5521"><div class="py-3"><p>Excellence scholarships are awarded to students enrolled in a Bachelor's degree at the University of St.Gallen on the <strong>basis of merit</strong>. The scholarship amount corresponds to the current tuition fees at the Bachelor level for a <strong>total of 6 semesters</strong>.</p><p>Currently, the University of St.Gallen and the "Monique Dornonville de la Cour - Stiftung" award scholarships for excellence at the Bachelor level in cooperation with the Advice Center for Study Funding.</p><p>Enrolled students of the University of St.Gallen with an <strong>outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year</strong> are identified by the Advice Center for Study Funding&nbsp;and invited to apply for an Excellence Scholarship. An application without an invitation from the University of St.Gallen is not possible. In addition to the above-mentioned performance criterion, further selection criteria may be applied, depending on the funding source. The final selection of scholarship awardees is the responsibility of the relevant committees.</p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5522" role="button"> Recommendations of Bachelor students to Study Foundations<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17502" id="collapse-accordion-5522"><div class="py-3"><p>The University of St.Gallen cooperates with the <a href="https://www.studyfoundation.ch/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Swiss Study Foundation</a>&nbsp;and the <a href="https://www.studienstiftung.de/en/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">German Academic Scholarship Foundation</a>.</p><p>Enrolled students of the University of St.Gallen with an <strong>outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year</strong>, are identified by the Advice Center for Study Funding&nbsp;according to the respective selection criteria of the two study foundations and asked whether their data may be forwarded.</p><p>Currently, both study foundations also accept <strong>self-applications</strong>.</p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5523" role="button"> Excellence Scholarships of the University of St.Gallen for Master students<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17502" id="collapse-accordion-5523"><div class="py-3"><p>A further excellence scholarship is the HSG Best Talents Programme (<a href="https://www.unisg.ch/en/studying/why-hsg/hsg-best-talents/" target="_blank">HSG Best Talents | unisg.ch</a>). This scholarship programme is for outstanding and engaged bachelor's graduates (EU/EFTA nationals or holders of the Swiss C permit) who wish to pursue a master's at HSG. Those who are accepted into the programme benefit from financial support as well as a personal development programme alongside their studies. To have a good chance of securing one of the coveted places, you need excellent grades and a demonstrated involvement beyond your studies. In addition, the selection process considers a sense of responsibility (towards society, the economy and the environment) and diversity of perspectives. Finally, we expect our Best Talents to promote and support future Best Talents after completing their studies, in the spirit of a strong alumni community.</p><p>Other Excellence Scholarships may be offered by Master's programmes. Please reach out to your respective Master's programme representative.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17503" ><header class="content-wrapper"><h2 class=" "> Tuition fees </h2></header><div class="tx-cs2-accordion font-size-regular"><div class="content-wrapper"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5524" role="button"> Deferment<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17503" id="collapse-accordion-5524"><div class="py-3"><p>For a deferment of the payment of tuition fees, please contact the&nbsp;<a href="/en/studying/orientation/advice-and-support/deans-advisory-office/">Dean's Advisory Office</a>&nbsp;of your level.</p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5525" role="button"> Partial or total remission<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17503" id="collapse-accordion-5525"><div class="py-3"><p>Students who are in <strong>urgent pressing unexpected financial straits</strong> can be granted a partial or total remission of tuition fees. The applicants’ and their parents’ financial and familial situation is essential and decisive.</p><p><strong>Application </strong>forms for partial or total remission of the tuition fees can be downloaded from the student portal <strong>Compass </strong>(<a href="https://compass.unisg.ch/studentrequests" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Request Study Funding</a>).&nbsp;</p><p>The <strong>deadline </strong>for the submission of the application form incl. required enclosures is <strong>1. October and 1. March.</strong></p><p>Please note that besides the form, further documents are required for means testing, which means it will take some time to complete the application. Forms that have not been duly completed will not be processed!</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="frame-space-after-large"></div></div><div id="c17504" ><header class="content-wrapper"><h2 class=" "> Scholarship Directories </h2></header><div class="tx-cs2-accordion font-size-regular"><div class="content-wrapper"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5526" role="button"> Scholarship and grants database<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17504" id="collapse-accordion-5526"><div class="py-3"><p>The scholarship and grants database <strong>Funding Finder </strong>provides information for University members of all levels (Bachelor's level to assistant professor) containing data on more than 150 private and state institutions that award scholarships, loans, grants etc.. This extensive but not exhaustive list is continually updated.</p><p><a href="http://funding.unisg.ch/en" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">Funding Finder</a></p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5527" role="button"> Foundation directory<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17504" id="collapse-accordion-5527"><div class="py-3"><p>A complete list of the over 2,700 traditional Swiss foundations can be found in the Swiss Federal Government's foundation Directory (only in German).</p><p><a href="https://www.edi.admin.ch/edi/de/home/fachstellen/eidgenoessische-stiftungsaufsicht/stiftungsverzeichnis.html" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">Foundation directory</a></p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5529" role="button"> ESKAS - Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17504" id="collapse-accordion-5529"><div class="py-3"><p>The Swiss Confederation grants scholarships for foreign students with a university degree (postgraduate) through the Federal Commission for Scholarships. Swiss government scholarships are granted for students from selected countries.</p><p><a href="https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/sbfi/en/home/education/scholarships-and-grants/swiss-government-excellence-scholarships.html" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships</a></p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5530" role="button"> «Social assistance from A to Z»<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse " data-id="17504" id="collapse-accordion-5530"><div class="py-3"><p>Online directory of addresses for social aid («Soziale Hilfe von A-Z») with over 3000 organisations from the entire social sector of the Canton of Zurich, selectable according specific needs (only in German).</p><p><a href="https://adressverzeichnis.sozialearbeit.zhaw.ch/" target="_blank" class="icon-link link-arrow-before" rel="noreferrer">«Soziale Hilfe von A bis Z»</a></p></div></div><h4 class="m-0 py-5 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between accordion-title collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#collapse-accordion-5531" role="button"> «The perfect request»<span class="material-icons icon-5" data-nosnippet >expand_less</span></h4><div class="accordion-content collapse "
